Por Profissional and Por Item tables both expose Custo and Lucro columns.

service-level commission_percent override still wins (svcD scenario: prof 30% / svc 60% / price 200 / cost 50 -> profit 150 -> commission 90).

Frontend ServiceModal: svc-cost optional input next to Preco; svc-profit-hint shows 'Lucro: R$ 60.00 (base da comissao)' when price=100 cost=40 (verified visually).
Frontend ComissoesPage: 4 cards rendered (stat-revenue, stat-profit, stat-commission, stat-appointments); stat-avg-ticket fully removed (count=0).
commission-base-hint correctly conditional: rendered only when summary.total_cost > 0. With current seed data total_cost=0, hint is hidden — expected.

Per-Profissional table headers: PROFISSIONAL | ATEND. | FATURAMENTO | CUSTO | LUCRO | % COMISSAO | VALOR COMISSAO. Per-Item table headers: ITEM | TIPO | QTD | FATURAMENTO | CUSTO | LUCRO | % COMISSAO | VALOR COMISSAO.

success_rate.frontend: 100% UI elements present and rendering correctly
